action: No action needed. If mail seems delayed, check the Google Workspace status dashboard and confirm important messages arrived before assuming a wider problem.
exec: User-reported Gmail problems that Google has not confirmed; no sign of a wider service failure or security issue.
plain: Some Gmail users reported trouble sending and receiving email on November 16 and 17. Google says it sees no evidence of a broad disruption, and there is no indication of a cyberattack.
summary: Downdetector reports of Gmail trouble peaked Monday afternoon and rose again Tuesday morning. Google says it sees no evidence of a broad Gmail service disruption and its status dashboard shows no problems. Cyber cause: not indicated.
title: Gmail users report sending and receiving problems; Google sees no broad disruption

validation.note: One outlet; user reports only, not confirmed by Google.
